title: Everyday Phrases — Board Game Night
scene_zh: 桌遊之夜 · 情境對話
title_quote: Are you ready for game night?
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🎲 實用桌遊之夜必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A2 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Board Game Night
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用到朋友家玩桌遊情境對話：邀約選遊戲、講解規則、對局拉扯、決勝收納，全程不卡關。每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Board Game Night phrase pairs — inviting friends, learning rules, mid-game banter, and packing up. Each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you ready for game night?
dialogue.zh: 你準備好今晚的桌遊之夜了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 準備好了，我也邀請了山姆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we ask Leo as well?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell him to bring dice cups.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, our cups are old.
dialogue.zh: 好主意，我們的骰盅都舊了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 太好了，剛好是我們整群人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which game should we open with?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How about the one with maps?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It takes too long, skip that.
dialogue.zh: 那個太花時間，先跳過吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This card game is my favorite.
dialogue.zh: 這款卡牌遊戲是我的最愛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's easy for new players too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But Anna really wants to play this one.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ˈænə ˈrɪli wɑnts tu pleɪ ðɪs wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 可是安娜很想玩這一款。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, we'll play what Anna wants.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，那就玩安娜想玩的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me clear the table first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The board fits on this side.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put the box under the table.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, grab two from the kitchen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This seat is a bit wobbly.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The lights are bright enough, right?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we can read the cards.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The snacks arrived right on time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should I pour for everyone?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep drinks away from the board.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good point, use the side table.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where did you put the plates?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And take the trash bag too.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's count all the game pieces.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll read the list for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many cards should there be?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The box says one hundred eight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 可能是別的遊戲混進來的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just two, we need three more.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They come with this new edition.
dialogue.zh: 這些是新版隨盒附贈的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The board looks a little bent.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 用書壓一壓，隔夜就會平了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 一切差不多都準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這屋子四處都是爆米花香。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I made a big bowl already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ben is bringing his cousin Kate.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is Kate good at board games?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No idea, but she learns fast.
dialogue.zh: 不清楚，不過她學得很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, the board has a problem.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ, ðə bɔrd hæz ə ˈprɑbləm./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 用膠帶貼好，沒人會發現。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那款有動物的農場遊戲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh nice, I love that game.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's calm but really sneaky fun.
dialogue.zh: 它看似平實，其實暗地裡很愛耍心機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My phone is on silent now.
dialogue.zh: 我的手機已經調靜音了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A new player always deals first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Kate never played, so she deals.
dialogue.zh: 凱特沒玩過，所以該她發牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Poor thing, let me deal instead.
dialogue.zh: 她好可憐，我來替她發吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move the snacks to that stool.
dialogue.zh: 把零食挪到那張凳子上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 現在每個人都有喝的了吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the farming game it is.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You know this game, you explain.
dialogue.zh: 你最熟這遊戲，你來解說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Each round you get three actions.
dialogue.zh: 每回合你可以做三個動作。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any specific pile to draw from?
dialogue.zh: 要從哪一疊抽有規定嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Always take from the face-down deck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlweɪz teɪk frʌm ðə ˈfeɪs ˌdaʊn dɛk./
dialogue.zh: 一律從背面朝上的牌堆拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then place one worker on a spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn pleɪs wʌn ˈwɜrkər ɑn ə spɑt./
dialogue.zh: 然後放一個工人到一個格子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can two workers share one spot?
dialogue.zh: 兩個工人能共用一格嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, one worker per spot only.
dialogue.zh: 不行，一格只能放一個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Watch me, I'll show one turn.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I draw, then place this farmer here.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ drɔ, ðɛn pleɪs ðɪs ˈfɑrmər hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我抽牌，再把這農夫放這邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So simple, I can do that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me think for a second.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 放在你的田地旁邊，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pick a color for your pieces.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 綠色、紅色、黃色，還有更多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Green it is, I love green.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we choose character cards too?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, each character has one power.
dialogue.zh: 對，每個角色一項特殊能力。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He earns extra coins per round.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can pick the builder instead.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the first player get fewer cards?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə fɜrst ˈpleɪər ɡɛt ˈfjuər kɑrdz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, everyone else draws one more.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 設計師什麼都替你想到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never sell grain in round one.
dialogue.zh: 第一回合絕對不能賣穀物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What happens if I break the rule?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ˈhæpənz ɪf aɪ breɪk ðə rul?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Each cow, and each wheat field.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do markets count at the end?
dialogue.zh: 市場到結算時也算分嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you own three matching.
dialogue.zh: 除非你湊齊三個一樣的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 所以收齊成套的卡很關鍵。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 正是，結算時會額外加分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we trade with any player?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 只能跟左手邊那位交換。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the neighbor says no?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who keeps track of the rounds?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我們輪流負責，一人一局。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll track first, I'm good with numbers.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl træk fɜrst, aɪm ɡʊd wɪð ˈnʌmbərz./
dialogue.zh: 我先來記，我數字最在行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I ask about rules mid-game?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ æsk əˈbaʊt rulz ˈmɪd ˌɡeɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 遊戲中途可以問規則嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What's the page number for scoring?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 大聲再念一遍，讓大家聽清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Any special rule for eight players?
dialogue.zh: 八人局有什麼特殊規則嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Shuffle again, then cut the deck.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Cut here? The deck looks mixed.
dialogue.zh: 從這兒切？牌看起來洗勻了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why do you get that coin?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The merchant gets it every game.
dialogue.zh: 商人每局都固定拿這枚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 很公道，那就是商人的紅利。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I peek at your board?
dialogue.zh: 我可以偷看你的棋盤嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Looking is fine, pointing is not.
dialogue.zh: 可以看，但不準用手指指點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 開局佈置看起來全搞定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twelve green, twelve blue, twelve red.
dialogue.zh: 綠色十二、藍色十二、紅色十二。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Twelve yellow, plus four more sets.
dialogue.zh: 黃色十二枚，另外還有四套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 作弊就直接出局喔朋友們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, deep breath, here we go.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: May the best player win tonight.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, roll and place a worker.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice six! The game is live.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 現在我要打出這張市場卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh right, I forgot the cost.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save it, you need coins first.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fine, I'll build a well instead.
dialogue.zh: 好吧，那我改打一口水井。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A well is a smart play.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那條規則最近有改過嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check the question sheet.
dialogue.zh: 我查一下疑難解答那張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So my move counts this time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The die slipped, can I reroll?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It fell off the table, sure.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey, why did you move two?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bridge lets me go two.
dialogue.zh: 走過橋可以讓我有兩步。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Show me that in the rules.
dialogue.zh: 規則哪裡寫的，指給我看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Line twelve, see the bridge icon?
dialogue.zh: 第十二行，看到橋的圖案沒？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll block Ben, you take grain.
dialogue.zh: 我來封住本的路線，你收穀物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ben keeps staring at us two.
dialogue.zh: 本一直盯著我們兩個看。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Legal, but they end at scoring.
dialogue.zh: 合法，但結算時就得解散。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sorry, I'm stuck on one choice.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉，我卡在一個選擇上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Buy the ox before the market.
dialogue.zh: 買市場卡之前先買耕牛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Too late, Ben heard it all.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, everyone gets the same tip.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Who turns it, you or me?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Flip it when you start thinking.
dialogue.zh: 一開始思考就把沙漏翻過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, sand is falling now.
dialogue.zh: 明白，沙子已經開始漏了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 時間到，你必須做出選擇。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The rule says no extra time.
dialogue.zh: 規則寫著沒有加時這回事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, I'll place my last card.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 壓迫之下這步救得漂亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 老實說我心跳都加速了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did anyone flip the timer twice?
dialogue.zh: 有沒有誰把計時器翻了兩次？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那你這一回合要扣十秒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I draw, and I take this one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ drɔ, ənd aɪ teɪk ðɪs wʌn./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hey, that was my discard pile!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It was mine, you took it.
dialogue.zh: 它本來是我的，卻被你拿走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Swap it back, no harm done.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This card says steal one coin.
dialogue.zh: 這張卡寫著可偷一枚錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't you dare steal from me!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I play two cards at once?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ pleɪ tu kɑrdz æt wʌns?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以一次打出兩張嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if the second is free.
dialogue.zh: 只有第二張不用錢才行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Any card with the leaf mark.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mine has a leaf, double play!
dialogue.zh: 我這張有樹葉，連打兩張！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 夠機伶，我剛剛都沒注意到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The barn spot is already taken.
dialogue.zh: 穀倉那個位置早被人佔了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 去牧場那格吧，分數一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the corner of the card.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'm about to run out of cards.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪm əˈbaʊt tu rʌn aʊt ʌv kɑrdz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 把棄牌堆重新洗回牌堆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這局贏家下局拿到先手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your ox blocks my whole plan.
dialogue.zh: 你的耕牛堵死我整個佈局。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 說抱歉但不真抱歉，遊戲無情。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we agree to swap spots?
dialogue.zh: 我們能不能商量互換位置？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 錢款兩清，位置也換好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這一局走起來像在對弈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 是摻了種田和運氣的棋局。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need two good draws now.
dialogue.zh: 我現在非連抽兩張好牌不行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 一切聽牌堆的安排，沉住氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 放好了！我的回合到此結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 沒有一個人出聲，全神貫注。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yeah, I can't move at all.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I fold, you all beat me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 精采一局，分數咬得好緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's add up the final scores.
dialogue.zh: 我們來加一下最後總分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll count, you write it down.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 藍色三十八分，差一點點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Green wins it by three points!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 這根本是一場惡戰啊朋友們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我簡直不敢相信自己贏了！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What nearly cost me the game?
dialogue.zh: 是哪一步差點讓我輸掉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Round five, you sold the ox.
dialogue.zh: 第五回合，你把耕牛賣了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it powered your whole farm.
dialogue.zh: 對，它是你農場的動力源。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That one never crossed my mind.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same, I almost made that mistake.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，我差點也犯同樣錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Missing that market cost me points.
dialogue.zh: 沒搶到市場讓我丟了分。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不過那兩塊田地收穫很好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那個便條本留著，記筆記有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time, read the guide first.
dialogue.zh: 下回先把說明書讀一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 認同，我們這是邊玩邊學。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still can't believe that swap worked.
dialogue.zh: 我還是沒想到那次換位真的管用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Genius move, green stole the win.
dialogue.zh: 神來一筆，綠色就此逆轉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Kate, for a first game, wow.
dialogue.zh: 是凱特啦，第一次玩就這麼驚艷。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們把計分表拍張照吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 之後要炫耀就有證據了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it in our chat now.
dialogue.zh: 現在就把它放到我們的群組。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The trophy cup goes to green.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it on your shelf proudly.
dialogue.zh: 就神氣地擺上你的書架吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: First, sort the cards by type.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 市場的放一疊，田地的放一疊？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the dice in the small bag.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðə daɪs ɪn ðə smɔl bæɡ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the coins in the other one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə kɔɪnz ɪn ði ˈʌðər wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 硬幣則裝進另一個袋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Zip the bags so nothing spills.
dialogue.zh: 袋子拉鏈拉好才不會灑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good call, last time was chaos.
dialogue.zh: 說得對，上次就撒了一地。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The wooden pieces need their tray.
dialogue.zh: 木製棋子要放回它們的托盤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The insert keeps them in place.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fold the board along its lines.
dialogue.zh: 順著摺痕把棋盤折起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 輕一點，棋盤的邊角很容易破。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: All pieces back in the box?
dialogue.zh: 所有配件都回到盒子了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count once more, then close the lid.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt wʌns mɔr, ðɛn kloʊz ðə lɪd./
dialogue.zh: 再點一遍，然後蓋上蓋子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Top shelf, away from the cat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 桌面終於又恢復乾淨了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My brain is full, in a good way.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ breɪn ɪz fʊl, ɪn ə ɡʊd weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 腦袋塞得滿滿的，是開心的那種。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Same, that was a great night.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 下星期五同一時間再來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, it's in my calendar now.
dialogue.zh: 說定，我已經寫進行事曆了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should invite two more people.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，我們這群人越來越熱鬧了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next game, bring your dice cup.
dialogue.zh: 下回請把你的骰盅帶來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Will do, and the rule book too.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl du, ənd ðə rul bʊk tu./
dialogue.zh: 會的，規則書也一併帶上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We need to buy this game.
dialogue.zh: 我們真該把這款買回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Split the cost, share the fun.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anna, you host the week after.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her place, her snacks, her rules.
dialogue.zh: 她家、她的零食、她的規矩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 別挑太複雜的，玩個快的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll bring two quick card games.
dialogue.zh: 我帶兩款節奏快的卡牌遊戲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I had so much fun tonight.
dialogue.zh: 我今晚真的玩得好開心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, best game night yet.
dialogue.zh: 我也是，歷來最棒的一場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's rest our voices a bit.
dialogue.zh: 我們也讓喉嚨休息一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 笑到最後其實滿耗體力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who drove with the snack box?
dialogue.zh: 誰開車把零食箱帶來的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Leo did, his trunk's still open.
dialogue.zh: 是裡歐，他的後備箱還沒關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grab your leftovers, don't be shy.
dialogue.zh: 吃不完的通通帶走，別客氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll take the last chip bag.
dialogue.zh: 那最後一包薯片我要了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 會的，你開車也慢點，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One thing, we forgot the timer.
dialogue.zh: 對了，計時器落在我們家了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Grab it, it's our lucky hourglass.
dialogue.zh: 趕快拿上，那是我們的幸運沙漏。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What a night, dice and friends.
dialogue.zh: 多美好的夜晚，骰子與朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 明天就好好休息，沒有安排。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 剛好，玩遊戲的累是真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 每個人都拿了自己的外套嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All here, mine was on my arm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl hɪr, maɪn wʌz ɑn maɪ ɑrm./
dialogue.zh: 都在，我的早就搭在手上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn off the lights, game over.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not over, just paused till Friday.
dialogue.zh: 不是結束，只是暫停到週五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我已經開始數著日子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five more sleeps till game night.
dialogue.zh: 再睡五晚就是桌遊之夜。
